title: Vintage Sports Illustrated FRED LYNN Baltimore Orioles On Cover March 18, 1985
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Vintage Sports Memorabilia:Publications:Magazines
descriptionText: The product is a vintage Sports Illustrated magazine featuring Fred Lynn of the Baltimore Orioles on the cover from March 18, 1985. This original magazine is a collectible piece of vintage sports memorabilia that would be a great addition to any baseball fan's collection. With its vintage status and association with a legendary player and team, this magazine offers a unique glimpse into the world of baseball during that time period.
